URL: https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/utility-stocks-support-ftse-100-162826854.html
FTSE 100 close, Friday 17 July 2026: 10,600.37, +28.13 points (+0.27%).
London's FTSE 100 bucked the broader global selloff on Friday, closing higher as investors rotated into defensively positioned constituents amid a punishing session for technology and semiconductor stocks elsewhere.

QUOTE: Kathleen Brooks, analyst at XTB: "It is a risk off end to the week, as the global chip sell-off shows no sign of abating." She added that while the S&P 500 remains only 1% below its all-time high, "there could be further losses and price action in July suggests that the Q2 rally is now in the rear view mirror."
